data.name: Amalbena
data.gender_notes: Amalbena is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek words 'amal' meaning toil or work and 'bana' meaning strong or powerful. In Christian tradition, Amalbena is a name of deep devotion and strength. This name was believed to be given to those who endured great hardships and emerged victorious. The name Amalbena carries the meaning “Powerful, toil, to love” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Amalbena usually hope their child will grow to embody powerful, toil, to love and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Name of strength and endurance, inspiring resilience and faith in challenging times.
data.etymology: Amalbena belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Powerful, toil, to love.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Amalbena total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
